delivery.outcome: Detect hardcoded Python secret literals in positional-only and lambda defaults and in either side of name, attribute and literal-subscript comparisons. Preserve dynamic values, placeholders and normal existing detections. Join material patch0.20.129 through independent exact-head protected review, merge and immutable publication.

Align positional defaults against the complete positional-only plus ordinary argument sequence, also for lambda arguments. Examine all comparison operands symmetrically when a secret literal is present, preserving existing chained-name detection. Keep source and bundled checkers byte-identical, return only field names, and preserve public signatures and GOV-SECRET-001. Test both real modules independently with synthetic literals and dynamic, placeholder, ordinary-field and alignment negative controls.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded material patch through protected delivery; preserve all foreign or unknown work.

validation.evidence: Reproduce missed positional-only, attribute, subscript and reversed comparisons on the current checker, then pass regressions independently in source and bundle, including mixed positional alignment, async/lambda defaults, dynamic values, safe placeholders and chained comparisons.
Normal hooks, native23, root tests and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev pass. Independent protected review owns merge and native immutable129 publication.
